item.title: Ubisoft initiates colossal restructure to become a more 'gamer-centric' company
item.description: The publisher is restructuring around five 'creative houses' by implementing cost-cutting, project cancellations, and a more robust return-to-office mandate.

item.title: US video game spend up 3% in December, fuelled in part by 24% increase in subscription services
item.description: US consumer spending on video games reached $5.9 billion in December 2025, an increase of 3% year-over-year (YoY). This rise was partially fuelled by an increase in subscription services spend, which rose 24% from December 2024.

item.title: Queen's Blood will be 'enhanced' and 'powered-up' in FF7 Remake Part 3
item.description: Director Naoki Hamaguchi says that Rebirth's hit card game will be 'powered-up' in Part 3

item.title: Beast of Reincarnation Game Director Answers All Our Burning Questions
item.description: Today, Game Freak's upcoming action game Beast of Reincarnation reemerged at the Xbox Developer Direct. So I sat down with Kota Furushima, game director of Beast of Reincarnation, to chat about what we saw, as well as get some further details on what exactly the game will be.

item.title: The Big Fable Interview With Microsoft Developer Playground
item.description: IGN interviews Playground Games' founder and general manager, Ralph Fulton, on Microsoft's upcoming Fable reboot.

item.title: "We all have strong opinions within the studio" Microsoft
item.description: Microsoft are telling the world that the sooner we all switch to using generative AI tools in our day-to-day lives, the sooner we will 10x ourselves. Yet the corporation are still only finding haphazard pick up by videogame developers, including some of their own studios.

item.title: Nintendo producer Kensuke Tanabe, known for Metroid and Paper Mario, reportedly confirms retirement
item.description: Tanabe has reportedly confirmed that Metroid Prime 4 was his last Nintendo title.

item.title: A Steam Fest every 2.4 weeks: there are 22 planned for 2026
item.description: Steam writes: "We have 22 themed Fests coming in 2026, and challenged ourselves* to find a fun way to show the variety of games we'll be celebrating on Steam throughout the year."

item.title: Arknight Endfield halts Paypal payments after players were charged for transactions they didn't make
item.description: "We want to sincerely apologize to everyone affected", says Hyperglyph.

item.title: Highguard really is alive and even has a PS5 trophy list
item.description: The PlayStation 5 trophy list for Highguard is now out, offering further proof of life for Wildlight Entertainment's live-service hero shooter.
